title: Functional Ziplock bag organizer but cheap quality; tricky to get the magnets to line up
text:
Functional Ziplock bag organizer but cheap quality; tricky to get the magnets to line up. At the current price of $14.99, the low quality is as expected. This is a functional plastic four-compartment organizer to store different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). The unit has holes tinier than most other organizers but since this is hinged, the door can be opened. There are two center magnets (one on the top and one on the bottom) that hold the door closed. The bottom magnet fell out on mine and I had to reseat it. However, they are not lined up well and, as a result, the door stays ajar (see photo) unless I move the door into a position that catches with the magnet. The labels are etched into the compartments.

It comes with plastic mounting "nipples" that supposedly stick to a wall. However, I do not feel this would be secure as it might be too heavy when loaded for the adhesive to hold. I would use screws with plastic mollies if I were hanging this. If putting this in a drawer, there are rubberized feet already affixed to the bottom to prevent scratches or prevent it from sliding around. In addition, a tiny 1.5" level is provided to ensure the unit is level on the wall when hanging.

Note that when this is on the wall, the bags can fall out when loading, so it is best to fill the unit through the holes.

Overall, this is a low-end organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in one's cabinets. It is definitely a low-end unit but is competitively priced for the quality.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
